full_prompt_en: A square dreamlike night illustration shows a small dark-haired girl standing on a snowy hill, facing a black crow perched on a neighboring rise. The landscape is almost entirely blue. Two pale rounded hills sweep in from the lower corners and meet in a V-shaped valley at the center, leading into a deep turquoise forest. The girl stands just left of this meeting point, a slender black silhouette with a small pale profile, long straight hair, and a narrow dress patterned with tiny subdued floral marks. The crow stands lower and farther to the right, its angular body and beak distinct against the light snow. Behind them, tall tree trunks rise in a layered sequence, the nearest broad canopies made of delicate pale blue branches inside rounded crowns. More distant trunks fade into the teal darkness, giving the otherwise flat decorative scene a quiet sense of depth. The upper strip is a deep navy sky sprinkled with many tiny star points. Along the lower snow, small botanical motifs—fine leaves, seed heads, red berries, and occasional golden dots—add intricate near-ground detail without obscuring the large white-blue curves. The painting uses clean, simplified silhouettes and extremely fine branching linework, with a slightly grainy matte surface. No visible moon or lamp illuminates the scene; a diffuse cool glow seems to live in the snow and pale branches, while the central woodland remains darker. The limited palette moves through midnight blue, cyan, icy powder blue, black, and rare red and yellow accents. The composition feels hushed and enchanted, holding a tiny encounter between two dark marks within a much larger luminous winter pattern.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形梦境般夜景插画呈现一名深发小女孩站在雪丘上，面对停在邻近坡上的黑乌鸦。风景几乎全是蓝色。两座浅色圆坡从下方两角扫入，在中央交成V形谷口，将视线引入深青绿色森林。女孩站在交会处略偏左，是一条纤细黑剪影，露出小小浅色侧脸、长直发和带微弱花形记号的窄裙。乌鸦站在更低、更右的位置，棱角身体与鸟喙在浅雪前清楚。两者后面，高树干成层排列，最近的宽树冠由圆形冠内细致的浅蓝枝脉组成。更远树干退入青绿黑暗，为原本平面的装饰性景象带来安静纵深。上缘是撒满许多细小星点的深海军蓝天空。下方雪地上，细叶、籽头、红浆果和零星金黄点构成小型植物纹样，增加近处细节，却不遮住大的白蓝弧线。绘画采用干净简化剪影与极细分枝线，表面略有颗粒且哑光。没有可见月亮或灯照明；漫射冷光似乎存在于雪和浅枝内部，中央林地则更暗。有限配色在午夜蓝、青、冰粉蓝、黑之间移动，偶有红与黄点缀。构图安静而有魔法感，将两个深色标记之间的小小相遇包进更大的发亮冬日图案。
style_prompt_en: A dreamlike matte illustration relies on a narrow range of midnight blue, deep teal, cyan, and icy powder blue, punctuated by rare pinpoints of red and gold. Broad pale curved planes cross the lower frame and open toward a darker V-shaped central recess. Tall verticals and rounded upper masses rise behind them, their interiors filled with extremely fine branching lines that repeat at varying scales. Two tiny near-black accents sit apart along the pale curves, supplying a restrained focal dialogue. The background fades through layered teal values rather than hard linear perspective, while a top strip carries a delicate dusting of small bright points. Edges of large areas are clean and softly hand-painted; minute organic linework and faint grain provide the tactile detail. Light is cool and diffuse, seeming to emanate from pale planes and fine filigree without a visible source or sharp shadow. The composition is quiet and decorative, balancing expansive smooth areas against intricate repeated tracery.
style_prompt_zh: 梦境感哑光插画依赖午夜蓝、深青绿、青色与冰粉蓝的狭窄色域，由少量红与金色针点刺破。宽阔浅色弯曲平面横过下框，向更深暗的V形中央凹处打开。高竖线和圆浑上部体块在其后升起，内部填满极细分枝线，并以不同尺度重复。两处微小近黑点缀分居浅色弧线上，形成克制的焦点对话。背景通过分层青绿色值后退，而非硬线性透视；顶部色带撒有纤细亮点。大面积边缘干净而略带手绘柔感；微小有机线网与淡颗粒提供触感细节。光冷而漫射，仿佛从浅色平面和细致纹样内部散出，没有可见源头或尖锐阴影。构图安静而装饰性强，在宽广平滑区域与复杂重复线网之间求平衡。
theme_en: A small girl and black crow on snowy hills beneath delicate pale trees at night
theme_zh: 夜晚雪丘上，小女孩与乌鸦站在纤细浅色树木下
name: Lisa Graa Jensen
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
